title: copyMetadata
body:
## copyMetadata

Carry selected kinds of information from a source onto new copies of JPEG, TIFF, DNG, PNG, WebP and HEIF photos as typed values (any item can be the source), with exact text and rational pairs, declared conflict, absence and loss policies, and independent readback, byte-identical image data, a native before/after diff and a source-versus-output proof for every copy. Nothing is copied as a block.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Selected typed values only: MakerNotes, unknown tags, thumbnails and XMP structures are not copied, and the capture time and location groups are carried through the E3 writers, alone or in any union with the other groups.
- A copy never creates an Exif block or ExifIFD; a destination without one is refused per item, because creating it would change what an untouched GPS-only height means.
- Device serial numbers identify physical equipment and are carried only when you select them.
- A destination container without an IPTC slot (PNG, WebP, HEIF) declares the loss iptcNotAvailableInContainer instead of creating a carrier, and a HEIF destination without the needed Exif or XMP item is refused.

Native binding: `one perl exiftool -config "" process per item (the E2 copy writer): -GROUP:TAG=value assignments planned from typed values of an independent snapshot of the source (never -tagsFromFile, never a block or MakerNote copy, never authored as tags); -o stage/ID.jpg captured/ID.jpg`. Output kind: `["image","text"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `media` | The set of photographs and XMP sidecar files to read: either an explicit list of items or one folder. Every item is captured into the run before any native process starts, and every scanned folder entry is listed in manifest.json as included or excluded with a reason, so you can see exactly which files were and were not examined. | `{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","required":true,"minItems":1,"maxItems":512,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"sha256":{"type":"string","minLength":64,"maxLength":64},"sidecar":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096}}}}}},{"type":"object","properties":{"folder":{"type":"object","required":true,"properties":{"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"extensions":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":11,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"enum","values":[".jpg",".jpeg",".xmp",".tif",".tiff",".dng",".png",".webp",".heic",".heif",".avif"]}},"depth":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":2},"maxItems":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":512},"sidecars":{"type":"enum","values":["none","adjacent"]}}}}}]}` | **required** |
| `source` | Where the values come from: another item of this run, one captured file, explicit pairs, or the sidecar of each item. A source that is also a destination is read from its capture, never from an output. | `{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"object","properties":{"item":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true}}},{"type":"object","properties":{"file":{"type":"object","required":true,"properties":{"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"sha256":{"type":"string","minLength":64,"maxLength":64}}}}},{"type":"object","properties":{"pairs":{"type":"array","required":true,"minItems":1,"maxItems":512,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"from":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"to":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true}}}}}}]}` | **required** |
| `transfer` | Choose what is carried, by closed group or field: descriptive, rights, rating, place, captureTime, location, camera, exposure and deviceSerials, or individual field names. At least one group or field is required; unknown names are refused. No ExifTool tag name is ever authored. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"groups":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":9,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"enum","values":["descriptive","rights","rating","place","captureTime","location","camera","exposure","deviceSerials"]}},"fields":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":23,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"enum","values":["title","description","keywords","creator","copyright","rightsUrl","rating","locationCity","locationCountry","captureTime","location","cameraMake","cameraModel","lensMake","lensModel","exposureTime","fNumber","isoSpeed","focalLength","focalLength35mm","exposureBias","bodySerialNumber","lensSerialNumber"]}}}}` | **required** |
| `policies` | How to resolve choices the data cannot decide. The accepted members depend on the operation: editMetadata (iptc, otherLanguages, exifEncoding, companionLoss), correctTime (sourceConflicts, preferFamily, subSecond, uncorrectedItems), setLocation (staleCompanions, xmp, createExif, altitudeNotExpressible, removeDirection, uncorrectedItems) and geotagFromTrack (those of setLocation plus gpsStamp and maxSpeedMetersPerSecond). Every member is optional; the effective plan echoes all of them with their defaults. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"existing":{"type":"enum","values":["replace","keepDestination","refuseConflict"]},"absent":{"type":"enum","values":["leaveDestination","clearDestination"]},"ambiguous":{"type":"enum","values":["refuseItem","skipField"]},"loss":{"type":"object","properties":{"iptc":{"type":"enum","values":["ifPresent","always"]},"otherLanguages":{"type":"enum","values":["keep","remove","refuse"]},"exifEncoding":{"type":"enum","values":["utf8","ascii"]},"companionLoss":{"type":"enum","values":["removeCompanion","refuse"]}}}}}` | omitted |
